items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-10-07
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...I didn't like it, Tommy. [INTERVIEWEE] Oh, I don't think so. I don't know. I don't know.

ctx.x: Ain't George Washington a dog fella? No, I think he was a short fella.

Little short guy, George Washington. George Washington, no. I know George Washington. Let's see. I wonder if it could have been uh... I wasn't Dave the bass player. I wasn't Dave the bass player. I didn't like it, Tommy.
Oh, I don't think so. I don't know. I don't know.
